news.title: Nani And Srikanth Odela Clarify Controversy Around Trolled Dialogue In The Paradise
news.summary: Hero Nani and director Srikanth Odela recently addressed audience backlash regarding a specific line in their movie The Paradise. The director explained that a crucial childhood sequence was edited out to reduce runtime, which caused the heroine's mother calling her a single-take artist to feel ironic rather than clear. Nani noted that losing necessary setups during editing often leads viewers to misunderstand well-intended payoffs. Meanwhile, the Sudhakar Cherukuri-produced and Anirudh Ravichander-musical venture is nearing the Rs 150 crore gross milestone by its opening weekend.

news.title: Sai Durga Tej Starrer Sambarala Yeti Gattu To Stick To Sankranti Release Plans
news.summary: Makers of the upcoming mass action entertainer Sambarala Yeti Gattu have confirmed they will not alter their theatrical arrival schedule despite overlapping dates with Mega Star Chiranjeevi's project. Producer Chaitanya Reddy stated that post-production is nearing completion and the team remains locked into the Sankranti festival slot. Headlined by Sai Durga Tej and directed by newcomer Rohith KP, the movie features Aishwarya Lekshmi as the female lead alongside a supporting cast.

news.title: Hombale Films Acquires Southern Rights For Blockbuster Hindi Hit Hanuman Ansh
news.summary: Following a massive box office run in the Hindi belt approaching Rs 300 crores, the low-budget biographical drama Hanuman Ansh is heading to southern markets. Hombale Films has secured the regional dubbing rights to distribute the film across multiple southern languages after initial plans with Trivikram Srinivas did not materialize. Directed by Vishal Chaturvedi and based on his book Divine Detour: That Changed My Life, the trilogy's first installment chronicles the early journey leading to the transformation of Neem Karoli Baba.

news.title: NTR Set to Resume Dragon Filming in Mumbai
news.summary: Following a recovery break from a shoulder injury, actor NTR is scheduled to get back in front of the camera for Prashanth Neel's directorial project, Dragon. A two-week schedule starting October 10th in Mumbai will focus on capturing a heavy-duty action sequence. The film features a prominent cast including Rukmini Vasanth, Anil Kapoor, and Biju Menon, with music scored by Ravi Basrur.

news.title: Anil Ravipudi's January 12 Vidudala Nears Completion
news.summary: Director Anil Ravipudi is wrapping up the final stages of his upcoming movie, January 12 Vidudala, starring Venkatesh, Kalyanram, Keerthy Suresh, and Krithi Shetty. Production is set to resume with a schedule in Ooty during the first week of October, followed by overseas song shoots. The makers plan to wrap up all filming by mid-November, leaving ample time for GV Prakash Kumar's background score and post-production work.

news.title: Chakkora Trailer Unveils a Unique Blend of Romance and Mystery
news.summary: The theatrical trailer for Chakkora – Lunar Love Bird was launched in Hyderabad, showcasing a narrative that mixes romance, family drama, and suspense. The plot follows a care-free youth named Ravana Brahma whose world turns upside down when his love interest, Julie, suddenly goes missing. Directed by Manga Srinivas, the movie is slated for a worldwide theatrical release on October 9.

news.title: Fresh Posters of Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana Highlight Scale and Devotion
news.summary: The makers of the high-profile mythological project Ramayana have released new promotional stills showcasing Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, and Ravi Dubey as Ram, Sita, and Lakshman against a grand natural backdrop. Additionally, a striking first-look poster of Yash as the antagonist Ravana has been revealed, highlighting his regal crown and fierce presence. Produced by Namit Malhotra, the epic cinematic venture is split into parts targeting Diwali releases in 2026 and 2027.

news.title: Chakkora Trailer Blends Youthful Romance With Mystery
news.summary: Aakash Jagannadh unveiled the trailer for Chakkora – Lunar Love Bird in Hyderabad, highlighting a youthful love story that evolves into an emotional mystery. Directed by debutant Manga Srinivas and starring Sravan alongside Malaika T. Vasupal, the movie is scheduled for a worldwide theatrical release on October 9. The project features music by Prince Henry and is produced under High Joy Commercials and Vintage Iconic Pictures.

news.title: Nani's The Paradise Pulls Strong Weekend Numbers Despite Mixed Reviews
news.summary: Despite opening to a mixed critical response, Nani's starrer The Paradise has posted solid box office collections, grossing 136 crore worldwide in its first three days. Directed by Srikanth Odela and backed by producer Sudhakar Cherukuri, the film continues to draw strong bookings in the Telugu states and overseas markets like the UK and Australia. The core team recently celebrated the film's early run alongside actor Mohan Babu.

news.title: NTR Set to Resume Dragon Shooting in Mumbai Next Month
news.summary: Actor NTR is gearing up to return to the sets for an upcoming 15-day shooting schedule in Mumbai starting October 10. The pan-India project, directed by Prashanth Neel and produced by Mythri Movie Makers, will feature high-octane action sequences involving NTR and Anil Kapoor. This marks the actor's return to filming following a recovery period from a shoulder surgery.

news.title: The Paradise Faces Critical Box Office Test Ahead of Weekdays
news.summary: Nani's big-budget venture The Paradise heads into a crucial weekday box office phase following a massive opening weekend marred by mixed reviews. While the film has pulled in strong initial numbers toward its multi-crore target, its ultimate financial success relies heavily on sustaining steady attendance. Fortunately, the lack of major competing releases next week provides a clear window for the movie to stabilize its run.

news.title: Fresh Character Posters Unveiled for Ramayana
news.summary: The makers of the upcoming multi-part epic Ramayana have released striking new character visuals. The promotional materials feature Yash in a commanding avatar as Ravana, alongside a composed trio shot of Ram, Lakshmana, and Sita. Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, the project is scheduled for theatrical releases during Diwali in 2026 and 2027.

news.title: Special Promo on the Way to Reveal Tabu's Role in King100
news.summary: A dedicated character teaser is being prepared for release to introduce Tabu's involvement in Nagarjuna Akkineni's milestone project King100. The film reunites the veteran actors decades after their hit 1990s collaboration Ninne Pelladutha. Directed by Ra Karthik, the movie is lined up for a theatrical launch on December 24, 2026.

news.title: Promotional Four-Part Documentary Series Announced for Ranabaali
news.summary: To build anticipation for Rahul Sankrityan's historical drama Ranabaali, the team is launching a four-part docu-series titled Ranabaali: Never Forget. Featuring lead actor Vijay Deverakonda, Rashmika Mandanna, and the director, the project highlights two years of historical research. The film itself is set to hit the big screen on October 16, 2026.

news.title: KTR Applauds Nani Starrer The Paradise After Hyderabad Screening
news.summary: BRS Working President KTR recently caught a screening of Nani's latest movie, The Paradise, at Sudarshan Theatre in Hyderabad. He praised the cast and crew, highlighting how the film effectively captures Telangana's distinct culture and depicts the struggles of marginalized communities against oppression.

news.title: Rashmika Mandanna Commands Higher OTT Valuation Than Sai Pallavi
news.summary: Industry insiders report that Rashmika Mandanna currently commands a significantly higher market value on digital streaming platforms compared to Sai Pallavi. Her involvement in multiple successful pan-Indian blockbusters and her immense social media popularity have largely driven this valuation gap.

news.title: The Paradise Maintains Strong Ticket Sales on Day 3
news.summary: Despite facing mixed audience reviews, Nani's action drama The Paradise is maintaining steady box-office momentum. The film registered around 252K ticket sales on BookMyShow for its third day, following a massive opening weekend.

news.title: Bigg Boss Telugu Season 10 Witness Shocking Exit With Cash Deal
news.summary: Wildcard contestant Mithilesh surprised viewers of Bigg Boss Telugu Season 10 by accepting a ₹15 lakh cash offer and exiting the show just a day after entering. He explained that changing house dynamics made winning impossible, making his swift departure a historic moment for the reality series.

news.title: Nani Expresses Joy Over The Paradise Journey
news.summary: During a press meet in Hyderabad, actor Nani celebrated the success and audience embrace of his latest movie, The Paradise. He praised the relentless hard work of the entire cast, crew, and technicians, calling the film a long-distance runner at the box office.

news.title: Mohan Babu Calls His Role in The Paradise His Deadliest Yet
news.summary: Veteran actor Mohan Babu shared his excitement about working in Srikanth Odela's directorial venture, The Paradise. He stated that in his five-decade career, he has never played such a deadly character and credited the director for extracting a phenomenal performance from him.

news.title: Nani Highlights The Paradise's Unique Box Office Turnaround
news.summary: Actor Nani pointed out at a recent media gathering that The Paradise experienced a rare positive shift, turning initial negativity into glowing praise with every passing screening. The Srikanth Odela directorial features an ensemble cast including Mohan Babu, Raghav Juyal, and Sonali Kulkarni.

news.title: Pen Studios Secures All-India Theatrical Rights for Sanjay Leela Bhansali's Love And War
news.summary: Following a massive deal for Shah Rukh Khan's King, Pen Studios has acquired the pan-India theatrical rights for Sanjay Leela Bhansali's upcoming directorial Love And War through a commission-based agreement via Pen Marudhar. Headlined by Ranbir Kapoor, Alia Bhatt, and Vicky Kaushal alongside Supriya Pathak, the movie is scheduled to hit theaters during Republic Day week on January 21, 2027, with Netflix securing post-theatrical streaming rights.

news.title: MrBeast Surprises Fans with 'Jai Shri Ram' Chant at Mumbai Ramayana Event
news.summary: Popular American YouTuber MrBeast made a surprise appearance at a grand Mumbai promotional event for director Nitesh Tiwari's upcoming Diwali 2026 release, Ramayana. Invited by the makers to boost global visibility, MrBeast drew massive attention on the red carpet and chanted “Jai Shri Ram” after Ranbir Kapoor explained the phrase to him. Meanwhile, the absence of Yash, who portrays Ravana in the ambitious project, sparked various discussions among fans online.

news.title: Mani Ratnam Applauds Karthik Subbaraj and LGBTQ-Themed Film Dorothy
news.summary: Veteran filmmaker Mani Ratnam has openly lauded director Karthik Subbaraj and his recent progressive venture Dorothy, which stars Keerthy Suresh. The acclaimed director praised Karthik's unconventional narrative style, language execution, and handling of a sensitive LGBTQ-themed storyline. Although the movie has ignited intense public debate and critical appreciation, it has not yet been dubbed or released in Telugu.
